soilWarning: Winter wet at the roots is the killer

resilience: Evergreen and drought tolerant · earns its place on hot dry ground
uses: Coastal and gravel gardens · sunny borders · pots · silver schemes
uncertain: Frequently labelled Senecio 'Silver Dormouse'. Accepted trade presentation is Brachyglottis Walberton's Silver Dormouse ('Walbrach').
peak: supplied research said "Summer"; converted to Jun-Aug so the app can parse it. Not from a source that stated months.
